## Information
Bring an eye-catching festive glow to your home or garden with the Christow Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Standing 100cm tall, it has eight illuminated strings arranged beneath a glowing star to create a classic tree-shaped silhouette. Choose white, warm white, or multi-colour micro LEDs to match your Christmas theme, with eight light modes adding variety to the display. Requiring no mains socket, it’s easy to position on a lawn, patio, entranceway, or inside your home. Classic Maypole Silhouette Eight strings sweep from the illuminated star topper down to the base, creating an enchanting maypole tree silhouette. Each string contains 17 micro LEDs, with 10 more inside the star. Together, the 146 micro LEDs create an eye-catching festive glow. 8 Light Modes with Memory From subtle glows to livelier effects, cycle through eight different lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood. A built-in memory function conveniently recalls your previous selection, so the tree is always ready to shine your way when it’s switched back on. Battery Powered with Built-In Timer An IP44-rated battery box powers the tree, allowing you to position it without a nearby mains socket. A 1m black lead connects the battery box to the base, while the timer switches the lights on at the same time each evening before turning them off six hours later. Quick Assembly & Outdoor Stability The base arrives ready-assembled to reduce setup time. Simply join the pole sections, then connect the light strings from the star topper to the base. Four U-shaped ground stakes help anchor the tree securely on soft ground – ideal for a lawn display. ## Features
- Premier
- 500 LED
- Treebright string lights
- Multi Coloured
- 12.5M lit length

## Information
This set of 500 LED string lights are set out on a green cable which helps to blend them well into your Christmas tree. Featuring 3 times as many LEDs per meter as regular lights, they will create a beautiful cluster effect when lighting up your tree. The bulb spacing along the set is 2.5cm. With their multi action feature and timer setting, the lights can be set between 8 of its lighting functions including a static setting, which will light up automatically for 8 hours and switch off for 18 hours at the same time each day. So, you won't need to worry about remembering to turn them off every time! The lights have a large 12.5M lit length range and are specially designed for trees up to 1.5M (5ft) in height with a 5M lead cable. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use, these eco friendly LED lights are the perfect addition to lighting up your tree or garden during this festive season. Saving you 90% on energy costs too! (Transformer must be located indoors or in a weatherproof box).

## Information
Make your home look like a winter wonderland with these LED Hanging Icicle Christmas Lights from Christow. Beautifully decorated with strands of hanging LEDs to resemble shiny icicles. Perfect for adding a festive glow to rooflines, banisters - even a mantelpiece! Mains powered with an IP20-rated UK transformer plug for indoor sockets only. Designed with a 5m long cable, giving you plenty of length to plug them indoors if displaying outside. Hanging the icicle lights from guttering With most guttering being white, the icicle lights have white cables. Allows them to blend in seamlessly for a more attractive light display. Beautifully lit by strands of 5mm LEDs to resemble sparkly, shimmery icicles and create a spectacular light display. Although the LEDs are ultra-bright for an enchanting festive glow, they're also low power, energy efficient, and low cost to run. Love a bit of festive sparkle Select from 8 light sequences, ranging from twinkly effects to a normal static glow. For convenience, we've also added a memory chip. So, the lights will always remember the last setting selected when turned back on. No need to worry about turning the lights on and off each night. Simply turn them on at your desired time when first using them. After that, they'll automatically light up at the same time every night. Plus, they'll automatically turn off after six hours.
